purpose: Frozen before any CUDA run: same-table CPU/CUDA transport comparison of the shipped exact/table/refined radiative-moment policies on the held-out cases, plus a launch-work and kernel-resource audit at benchmark scale.

reference.note: CPU records predate this protocol; no CUDA result for these seeds existed when it was frozen.

identity: Each CPU/CUDA pair must share primary coupling, packer source, table digests and the persisted moment model and moment_table_sha256; any mismatch aborts.

rules.core_difference: Per policy, paired CUDA-CPU differences per metric with the analyze_moment_transport Student-t rule: entire 99% interval inside margin is screening_pass, entirely outside is fail, fewer than 30 changed pairs or zero variance is unresolved, otherwise unresolved.
rules.table_core_interaction: For table and refined, the paired difference-in-differences (CUDA_policy - CUDA_exact) - (CPU_policy - CPU_exact) per metric under the same rule and margins: tests whether the same prepared table changes CUDA and CPU results differently.
rules.binary_discordance: For transmitted/backscattered, also report the one-sided exact-binomial CPU/CUDA discordance bound with Bonferroni alpha 0.01 over 8 cases x 3 policies x 2 metrics.
rules.unresolved: Unresolved is never counted as passing. Hard-count resolution belongs to #978.

multiplicity: Per-comparison 99% Student-t screening; no family-wise claim beyond the stated binary Bonferroni bound.

report: per-launch electrons, row capacity, threads per block and continuation flag
launched electrons beyond the primaries (capacity replays)
returned segments versus allocated row slots
registers, local bytes and theoretical occupancy of each launched kernel variant
work_audit.claim_limit: Instrumented diagnostic; its timings do not replace the moment-production-788 benchmark.
